text: Inca engineers built terraces that slowed erosion and created level growing ground on steep slopes; their stonework also helped manage water across varied mountain climates.
South Korea’s kimjang tradition brings neighbours together to make and share kimchi for winter; fermentation preserves vegetables, turning seasonal abundance into food that lasts.
For two minutes, watch a patch of ground or a tree from where you are; notice one wild creature, or signs such as tracks, chewed leaves or a spider’s web.
